easyPrerequisites:
Soul Diviner doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken non-Human creature that doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it or enter with +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the additional creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from the additional creature, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat
Activate Vish Kal's first activated ability by sacrificing Vish Kal.
Vish Kal's undying ability from Mikaeus triggers, returning Vish Kal from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the ability from step 1, failing to place a counter because Vish Kal left the battlefield.
Activate Vish Kal's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving target creature -1/-1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
